sourceServiceAudit.scope: Actual backing triangle centroids and cut body/adapter/cover triangles; source clear exit rays are separately tested against the actual imported runtime.

componentClearance.scope: Each actual outlet hood/lip/backing against all same-side louvre rims/backings/slats/hoods; shared edges alone are not penetration.

runtimeServiceAudit.scope: Every actual source clear exit ray remains clear in actual imported game geometry, including cut skins, rims and hoods. No material-factor substitution.

aoFieldAgreement.scope: Independent actual high/game GLB body rays and actual embedded PNG AO; includes both sides of the known UV1 seam.

normalInterpolationDiagnostic.scope: Diagnostic includes cap-center interpolation changes; not an export-coordinate identity gate.
